high_level_description: stc brand style, a man monitoring multiple screens displaying medical scan data and vital signs in a modern office.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dim modern office with wood-toned walls and warm accent lighting, with several large monitors mounted on the desk.

elements.desc: A man with short dark hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt, typing on a keyboard while looking at monitors.
Glowing blue and pink vital-sign readouts on the monitors, alongside a scanned image of a heart and a human torso with a highlighted chest area.
